selection: Direct configuration variation, realistic state changes, corruptions, error recovery, observation/accessibility constraints, and adversarial environment changes. Not a full copy of the directory.
less_direct_candidate_excluded: DiffSpot (fine-grained visual difference spotting; narrower perception rather than interactive environment variation)

direct_arxiv_pages_opened.interpretation: OpenApps changes app appearance/content and evaluates reliability across versions.
B-MoCA randomizes mobile configuration, including UI layouts and language settings.
WorldGUI systematically varies task initial states, enabling recovery/adaptation evaluation.
AgentHijack studies configurable common environment corruptions without necessarily adversarial intent.
GUI-RobustEval/RoTS focuses on recovery from policy-induced errors; retain as adjacent reliability, not as direct exogenous configuration variation.

quality_note: Candidates carry titles only as discovery hints. Parent must use opened paper metadata; directory venue labels were not copied.
